name: Vernal-Menhir
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are frozen methane lakes, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
